entries.text: A black cat begins to follow the party and returns no matter how hard they try to chase it off.
entries.raw_text: 1,A black cat begins to follow the party and returns no matter how hard they try to chase it off.

entries.text: A handsome man claims to be a woodcutter who lives in these woods. He invites the footsore party back to his home to rest for the night. He is actually a warlock who needs the party’s blood or souls for the ritual that keeps him youthful.

entries.text: A lone hanging tree stands in a clearing, with desiccated corpses still dangling from decrepit ropes.
entries.raw_text: 2,A lone hanging tree stands in a clearing, with desiccated corpses still dangling from decrepit ropes.

entries.text: A saddled horse flees a clearing in which wolves are feasting on its dead rider. The wolves pointedly ignore the horse in favor of the human flesh.
entries.raw_text: 2,A saddled horse flees a clearing in which wolves are feasting on its dead rider. The wolves pointedly ignore the horse in favor of the human flesh.

entries.text: A strange magical experiment gone wrong. Otherwise normal human with tentacles/extra limbs/eyes where they shouldn’t be. It attempts to make peaceful contact but might not know how.
entries.raw_text: 2,A strange magical experiment gone wrong. Otherwise normal human with tentacles/extra limbs/eyes where they shouldn’t be. It attempts to make peaceful contact but might not know how.

entries.text: A whole caravan slowly proceeds down the road flanked by well armed and armored mercenaries. The merchants in charge decided to take a shortcut through the woods.
entries.raw_text: 2,A whole caravan slowly proceeds down the road flanked by well armed and armored mercenaries. The merchants in charge decided to take a shortcut through the woods.

entries.text: All the trees along a river are withered. The river is either poisoned or cursed.
entries.raw_text: 2,All the trees along a river are withered. The river is either poisoned or cursed.

entries.text: An entire village where people wear fashions that are at odds with the current era. If the party stays for the night, the village will be gone in the morning, along with one of the characters. When the village appears at sundown, the character will reappear, believing him or herself to be a member of the village.
entries.raw_text: 2,An entire village where people wear fashions that are at odds with the current era. If the party stays for the night, the village will be gone in the morning, along with one of the characters. When the village appears at sundown, the character will reappear, believing him or herself to be a member of the village.

entries.text: An ornate carriage drives past the party - with no driver.
entries.raw_text: 2,An ornate carriage drives past the party - with no driver.

entries.text: An unmanned carriage almost runs the party over as it careens down the road pulled by panicked horses.
entries.raw_text: 2,An unmanned carriage almost runs the party over as it careens down the road pulled by panicked horses.

entries.text: Dozens of rats scurry past, either fleeing some unseen threat or hastening to some new feast.
entries.raw_text: 2,Dozens of rats scurry past, either fleeing some unseen threat or hastening to some new feast.

entries.text: It turns out that Heart Truffles, a local mushroom delicacy that is currently popular in roadside taverns for miles around, grow exclusively on rotting corpses.
entries.raw_text: 2,It turns out that Heart Truffles, a local mushroom delicacy that is currently popular in roadside taverns for miles around, grow exclusively on rotting corpses.

entries.text: Many flowering vines hang from trees in this area, the air is thick with their insanity-inducing pollen.
entries.raw_text: 2,Many flowering vines hang from trees in this area, the air is thick with their insanity-inducing pollen.

entries.text: Recent heavy rains have caused the river to wash away the bridge. The river’s still enlarged and running very swiftly, so the party may have to find another route or risk losing supplies or lives in a dangerous crossing.
entries.raw_text: 2,Recent heavy rains have caused the river to wash away the bridge. The river’s still enlarged and running very swiftly, so the party may have to find another route or risk losing supplies or lives in a dangerous crossing.

entries.text: Shambling corpses wander out of a nearby peat bog. They move very slowly due to lead balls weighing down their bodies.
entries.raw_text: 2,Shambling corpses wander out of a nearby peat bog. They move very slowly due to lead balls weighing down their bodies.

entries.text: Shrieking bats swoop down in the night and try to feast on the blood of the party or their mounts.
entries.raw_text: 2,Shrieking bats swoop down in the night and try to feast on the blood of the party or their mounts.

entries.text: The party comes upon an inexplicably blighted grove. What little fruit remains is blackened with rot and full of maggots.
entries.raw_text: 2,The party comes upon an inexplicably blighted grove. What little fruit remains is blackened with rot and full of maggots.

entries.text: The rain currently falling turns out not to be water but rather some strange substance such as blood or mercury.
entries.raw_text: 2,The rain currently falling turns out not to be water but rather some strange substance such as blood or mercury.

entries.text: Thick fog rolls in, making it hard to see much of anything. It becomes difficult to follow the road and might even conceal a natural hazard such as a ravine.
entries.raw_text: 2,Thick fog rolls in, making it hard to see much of anything. It becomes difficult to follow the road and might even conceal a natural hazard such as a ravine.

entries.text: Unlikely weather occurs. It begins to hail or snow on a warm summer day. Hot, steaming rain falls in the middle of winter causing reduced visibility due to the steam.
entries.raw_text: 2,Unlikely weather occurs. It begins to hail or snow on a warm summer day. Hot, steaming rain falls in the middle of winter causing reduced visibility due to the steam.

entries.raw_text: 2,What at first appears to be a somber funeral procession turns out to be a wedding parade - or vice versa.
